modelPlan.focus: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of tourism in less developed countries, focusing on socio-economic impacts and sustainable practices.
outline: body1: Advantages of tourism including economic growth and job creation
body2: Disadvantages such as overtourism and cultural preservation issues
keyArguments: Tourism can boost local economies and create jobs, but it also risks over-reliance and cultural dilution.
Sustainable tourism practices are essential to mitigate negative impacts and ensure long-term benefits.
